changes_made.controller_change: Added max_position_tau parameter and term-level clipping to SagittalVelocityDampedBalanceController
changes_made.rationale: Position hold is secondary to pitch balance. Clipping tau_position before summing prevents it from saturating wheel torque on its own.

candidates_tested.name: Candidate A
candidates_tested.failure_reason: Steady-state formula: (50/10) * 0.051 = 0.255 m. Position-return authority too weak to overcome pitch-driven drift.

candidates_tested.name: Candidate B
candidates_tested.failure_reason: Steady-state formula: (50/15) * 0.057 = 0.190 m. Position-return authority still too weak.

candidates_tested.name: Candidate C (1000 steps)
candidates_tested.note: Final error equals max — still drifting at step 1000, not yet at steady-state

candidates_tested.name: Candidate C (5000 steps)
candidates_tested.failure_reason: Large pitch disturbance at step 1360 (5.64 deg, height 0.365 m) caused support position error to peak at 0.595 m. Term-level clipping prevented wheel torque saturation but could not prevent position drift during pitch recovery.

fundamental_limitation.description: Position-return approach cannot simultaneously achieve tight position hold during large pitch transients AND preserve pitch balance authority.
fundamental_limitation.root_cause: During large pitch excursions, wheels must move forward to balance the robot. Position-return term fights this motion. Term-level clipping prevents wheel torque saturation but cannot prevent large position errors during pitch disturbances.
why_further_tuning_wont_help: Increasing k_position reduces steady-state drift but worsens transient peaks
Increasing max_position_tau risks saturating wheel torque and preventing pitch balance
Decreasing k_position worsens steady-state drift (Candidates A and B)

options_for_user.name: Accept Fallback Gate
options_for_user.description: Accept Candidate C as passing the fallback final-drift gate (<=0.10 m). Document transient peak as known limitation.
options_for_user.rationale: Steady-state performance is good. Robot recovers from disturbances without falling. Transient peak occurs during extreme pitch event, not nominal operation.

options_for_user.name: Pitch-Dependent Position Authority
options_for_user.description: Reduce max_position_tau during large pitch excursions to preserve pitch balance authority.
options_for_user.rationale: Would reduce transient peaks but requires additional logic and testing.

options_for_user.name: Redesign Position-Hold Strategy
options_for_user.description: Replace position-return term with velocity-based hold, pitch-reference adjustment, or separate position-hold mode.
options_for_user.rationale: Significant redesign required. Not recommended until base residual balance env works.

step_c_reason: Transient peak (0.595 m) exceeds both max-error gates. User must review and decide whether to accept fallback gate or pursue further improvements.
